purpose: Source-check the nine Human Geography and Population Studies (A05) records and eleven Social Research and Evaluation (A06) records; add direct evidence locators and free task-specific learning links.
authority: Evidence/resource review only. This ledger does not change item ownership, role fit, relationships, sequence, student visibility, canonical data, matcher data, graph data, or implementation.

source_registry.publisher: Open Textbook Library / University of Minnesota
source_registry.title: Fundamentals of Human Geography
source_registry.exact_locator: Table of Contents: Chapter 1 Introduction to Human Geography; Chapter 2 Population and Health; Chapter 3 Migration; Chapter 12 Human Settlements. Listing provides online and PDF formats under CC BY.
source_registry.scope_limit: Global introductory examples; supplement with current Nigerian data and local geography.

source_registry.publisher: QGIS Project / Open Source Geospatial Foundation
source_registry.title: QGIS Training Manual, version 3.44
source_registry.exact_locator: Contents: 2 Creating and Exploring a Basic Map; 3 Classifying Vector Data; 4 Laying out the Maps; 6 Vector Analysis (reprojecting/transforming, vector analysis, network analysis, spatial statistics); 13 Assessment (base map, analyse data, final map).
source_registry.access_cost: Free documentation and exercises; QGIS is open-source software
source_registry.scope_limit: Teaches software operations, not the validity of a social construct, local boundary authority, causal inference, or human-geography theory.

source_registry.title: 2030 World Population and Housing Census Programme
source_registry.exact_locator: Programme overview and Principles and Recommendations for Population and Housing Censuses, Revision 4: census as a primary source of disaggregated data; programme objectives include comparable, integrated and quality-assured census data.
source_registry.scope_limit: Census-system guidance; does not make census data automatically current, complete, comparable, or fit for every research question.

source_registry.title: Nigeria General Household Survey, Panel 2023-2024, Wave 5
source_registry.exact_locator: Catalogue sections Identification, Version, Scope and Sampling: nationally representative panel of about 5,000 households and six geopolitical zones; household geographic-area identification, migration, labour, education and other modules; anonymized public-distribution dataset metadata.
source_registry.access_cost: Metadata free; microdata access is subject to the catalogue's access conditions
source_registry.scope_limit: One survey round and its defined population; geographic identifiers and anonymization limit fine-scale use.

source_registry.publisher: International Union for the Scientific Study of Population / London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine
source_registry.title: Introduction to Demographic Methods and Population Analysis
source_registry.exact_locator: Course overview: 28 interactive self-study lectures in three modules covering measurement/analysis of fertility, mortality and migration, population projections, life tables and population models.
source_registry.scope_limit: Course materials developed in 2014-2015; introductory methods, no computing support or Nigerian source-system instruction.

source_registry.publisher: United Nations Statistics Division, Demographic and Social Statistics
source_registry.title: International migration statistics: methods and resources
source_registry.exact_locator: Methods/resources list includes 2025 Recommendations on Statistics of International Migration and Temporary Mobility, 2025 data-integration materials, 2022 Indicators, and the 2022 Handbook on Measuring International Migration through Population Censuses; page describes stocks, flows, data quality and comparability.
source_registry.scope_limit: International migration standards; concepts and data availability must be checked against the specific national source and study period.

source_registry.title: Exploring how migration changes the places where we live
source_registry.exact_locator: Course overview and sections on migration, cities, community, belonging, local authorities and inclusion; course text/videos explain how migration shapes places and communities.
source_registry.scope_limit: UK policy and city examples; use for concepts and interpretation, not Nigerian migration facts or statistical methods.

source_registry.publisher: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
source_registry.title: World Population Prospects 2024: Methodology report
source_registry.exact_locator: Methodology report for the UN's 2024 population estimates and projections; report defines projection uncertainty components and describes empirical inputs, estimation methods and model assumptions. Use the uncertainty and assumptions sections and variant results when interpreting projections.
source_registry.access_cost: Free official report and data portal
source_registry.scope_limit: UN global/national estimates and model assumptions; not a substitute for a fit-for-purpose local projection or a guarantee of future outcomes.

source_registry.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source_registry.title: CDC Program Evaluation Framework
source_registry.exact_locator: Evaluation Steps: assess context; describe the program; focus evaluation questions and design; gather credible evidence; generate and support conclusions; act on findings. The framework page identifies these steps as its evaluation process.
source_registry.scope_limit: Public-health framework with wider evaluation use; guidance, not Nigerian law, a credential, or a mandatory design for every study.

source_registry.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source_registry.title: CDC Program Evaluation Framework Action Guide
source_registry.exact_locator: Purpose and How to Use sections: practical how-to guide for planning, designing and implementing evaluations; stand-alone step-by-step material with evaluation standards, cross-cutting actions and a linked 60-minute self-guided module.
source_registry.access_cost: Free guide; linked self-guided module is 60 minutes
source_registry.scope_limit: Public-health framing and non-prescriptive guidance; adapt to local institutional and legal requirements.

source_registry.publisher: HM Treasury and UK Evaluation Task Force
source_registry.title: Magenta Book: Central Government guidance on evaluation
source_registry.exact_locator: Sections 2.2.1-2.2.2 on understanding an intervention, theory of change and evaluation purpose/questions; survey sampling section describes probability/non-probability sampling, representativeness and non-response; methods chapters cover evaluation design and evidence.
source_registry.scope_limit: UK central-government guidance; methodological reference, not Nigerian policy or a universal evaluation recipe.

source_registry.publisher: Anol Bhattacherjee / University of Southern Queensland Open Textbooks
source_registry.title: Social Science Research: Principles, Methods and Practices, revised edition
source_registry.exact_locator: Table of contents: Chapter 3 The research process; 5 Research design; 6 Measurement of constructs; 7 Scale reliability and validity; 8 Sampling; 9 Survey research; 11 Case research; 12 Interpretive research; 13 Qualitative analysis; 14-15 quantitative analysis; 16 Research ethics. Online text and downloads are listed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
source_registry.scope_limit: Compact foundational text; Chapter 16 includes Australian context and legal/institutional rules must be checked locally.

source_registry.title: AEA Evaluator Competencies
source_registry.exact_locator: Competency domains include methodology, context, planning/management and interpersonal practice; interpersonal domain names communication, facilitation and conflict resolution. The page describes a professional competency framework.
source_registry.scope_limit: Professional framework, not a licence, universal job requirement, or methods course.

source_registry.title: Guiding Principles for Evaluators
source_registry.exact_locator: Guiding Principles page and Systematic Inquiry principle: data-based, thorough, methodical and contextually relevant inquiry; the five principles also include competence, integrity, respect for people, and common good/equity.
source_registry.scope_limit: Professional ethics guidance, not Nigerian law or an institutional research-ethics approval.

source_registry.publisher: Nigeria Data Protection Commission; Act copy linked by Nigeria's ngCERT
source_registry.title: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023
source_registry.exact_locator: Official Act landing page and linked Act text; sections 24-25 address personal-data processing principles and lawful bases. For a study, check the current Act text and applicable institutional guidance rather than treating this note as legal advice.
source_registry.scope_limit: Nigerian data-protection law; does not by itself supply research-design or ethics-committee approval.

source_registry.title: Collecting data using web forms
source_registry.exact_locator: Overview and Offline data collection sections: web forms support configured form logic including skip logic and validation; offline use requires opening and caching the form before disconnecting, with queued submissions uploading after reconnection.
source_registry.scope_limit: Describes a platform implementation; test the actual device, project settings, security, consent flow and connectivity before field use.

source_registry.title: Exporting and downloading your data
source_registry.exact_locator: Downloading your data and Export types sections: project DATA > Downloads workflow and XLS, CSV, GeoJSON and SPSS Labels formats; CSV is described for import into data-management software and GeoJSON for GIS integration.
source_registry.scope_limit: Export format does not validate the questionnaire, sample, measure or analysis.

source_registry.title: Global challenges in practice: designing a development intervention
source_registry.exact_locator: Week 3 section 2, Why is evaluation important?; adjacent course sections distinguish monitoring and evaluation and discuss indicator choice. The course page identifies this as a free, 12-hour intermediate course.
source_registry.access_cost: Free course; free account for course tracking/participation statement
source_registry.scope_limit: Development-intervention context; introductory orientation rather than a full design manual.

source_registry.title: R for Social Scientists
source_registry.exact_locator: Learner lesson episodes: Starting with Data; Data Wrangling with dplyr/tidyr; Data Visualisation with ggplot2. The lesson description specifies an introductory R workflow for social-science data; its materials state alpha/under-development status.
source_registry.scope_limit: Optional software workflow; lesson is marked alpha and does not select a research design or establish statistical validity.

source_registry.title: Getting started with SPSS
source_registry.exact_locator: Course description and learning outcomes: seven interactive activities; define variables, enter basic data and carry out a statistical analysis to test hypotheses; no statistics software is needed for the course activities.
source_registry.access_cost: Free course; statement of participation available
source_registry.scope_limit: Introductory SPSS orientation; it does not teach study design, sampling or all statistical methods.

source_registry.title: Getting started with Taguette
source_registry.exact_locator: Start a project, upload materials, highlight/tag passages and export tags, highlights, codebooks, documents and project; supports a basic documented coding workflow.
source_registry.access_cost: Free and open-source tool with free documentation
source_registry.scope_limit: Software operation only; the researcher must select and justify the qualitative method, coding approach and interpretation.

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Spatial patterns, place and scale
records.source_check_finding: Human-geography chapters establish a people/place conceptual foundation; UN census guidance supports the relevance of disaggregated population data. Neither source makes spatial analysis necessary for every social question.
records.item_limit: Use a non-spatial table or qualitative place study when location is not material; map patterns do not establish causation.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Spatial data provenance, geographic units and scale
records.source_check_finding: UN census programme standards and NBS survey metadata support checking geography, coverage, reference period and source design before comparing mapped observations. NBS metadata is a concrete Nigerian exercise source.
records.item_limit: The GHS panel is not a census or a complete geographic register; inspect public-use access and anonymization before analysis.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Spatial analysis and map-based comparison
records.source_check_finding: QGIS manual provides direct vector-analysis, reprojection, spatial-statistics and map-assessment exercises; official census and NBS metadata ground data-quality requirements.
records.item_limit: Spatial association is not causal evidence; coordinate systems, boundary changes, missingness and unit choice can alter results.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: QGIS for a human-geography spatial workflow
records.source_check_finding: Official versioned QGIS manual covers loading/vector data, reprojecting, analysis, spatial statistics and map production in explicit modules.
records.item_limit: QGIS is an optional implementation; it cannot choose the research question, validate inputs, or establish a valid social interpretation.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Explain spatial patterns without overclaiming
records.source_check_finding: QGIS map-layout/final-map exercises support communication practice; the open text supplies human-geography context, and NBS metadata supports communicating coverage and unit limits.
records.item_limit: A polished map is not proof of a mechanism or causal effect; state alternatives, uncertainty and data limitations.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Population measures and demographic change
records.source_check_finding: The IUSSP/LSHTM lectures directly cover fertility, mortality, migration, life tables and population models; UNSD and NBS materials anchor migration definitions and data coverage.
records.item_limit: Define numerator, denominator, population, time period and source; international recommendations do not guarantee local data completeness.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Appraise census, survey and administrative population data
records.source_check_finding: UN standards distinguish census-system aims; the NBS Wave 5 catalogue exposes sampling, population coverage, geography, period and questionnaire scope for a tangible source-comparison exercise.
records.item_limit: A sample survey, census and administrative system have different populations, error structures and access conditions; do not treat them as interchangeable.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Interpret migration and urbanisation patterns
records.source_check_finding: Current UNSD resources define stock/flow and data-quality scope; NBS provides Nigeria-specific migration modules; OpenLearn connects migration with place, community and belonging.
records.item_limit: OpenLearn examples are UK-based; migration trends and urban change require dated, population-specific data and competing explanations.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.area: A05 Human Geography and Population Studies
records.label: Population estimation and projection with uncertainty
records.source_check_finding: UN WPP 2024 provides the official methodology and model assumptions for estimates/projections; IUSSP provides introductory projection and population-model instruction.
records.item_limit: Projection is conditional on inputs and assumptions; report uncertainty/scenarios and avoid presenting a projection as a forecast certainty.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Turn a social question into a feasible study design
records.source_check_finding: CDC and Magenta Book connect evaluation purpose/questions to design and evidence; textbook Chapters 3 and 5 provide a free research-process/design learning route.
records.item_limit: Formal study design is conditional on the task; the framework does not determine the right method for every population or question.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Sampling, measurement and representativeness
records.source_check_finding: Magenta Book's sampling section distinguishes probability and non-probability samples, non-response and inference limits; textbook Chapters 6-8 cover measurement, reliability/validity and sampling. NBS metadata supplies a real sampling design example.
records.item_limit: Representativeness depends on frame, selection, response and weighting; measurement quality and sample size alone do not guarantee valid inference.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Choose between surveys, interviews, focus groups and document methods
records.source_check_finding: Textbook Chapters 9 and 11-13 directly cover survey, case, interpretive and qualitative methods; CDC connects design to evaluation questions. OpenLearn gives a free evaluation orientation including qualitative/quantitative methods in its course contents.
records.item_limit: Methods are not interchangeable; choose according to question, evidence, access, ethics and inference target. The source text is foundational rather than exhaustive.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Protect participants and handle research data responsibly
records.source_check_finding: Nigeria's Act supplies local personal-data obligations (sections 24-25); AEA's principles support context-sensitive, respectful inquiry; textbook Chapter 16 is a free ethics learning section.
records.item_limit: Data-protection compliance is not equivalent to ethics approval or informed-consent adequacy; check current institutional and legal requirements for the actual study.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: KoboToolbox for electronic form collection
records.source_check_finding: Official Kobo documentation confirms form logic, validation, offline caching/queue behavior and data-export options, directly matching the implementation task.
records.item_limit: Tool use follows a justified instrument and sampling plan; test skip/validation logic, security and offline synchronization before collecting real data.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Describe how a programme is expected to produce change
records.source_check_finding: Magenta Book sections 2.2.1-2.2.2 describe theory of change, causal steps, assumptions, context, stakeholder testing and evaluation questions; CDC places programme description before question/design and evidence.
records.item_limit: A logic model records an explicit programme theory; it does not prove that the causal chain operates or that outcomes were caused by the programme.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Select evaluation questions, design and credible evidence
records.source_check_finding: CDC's six steps explicitly connect context, programme description, evaluation questions/design, credible evidence and conclusions; Magenta Book scopes evaluation purposes and method choices. Both have free practical learning material.
records.item_limit: Evaluation design depends on purpose and context; impact claims need a defensible comparison strategy, while process and descriptive evaluations can use other designs.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Turn findings into usable, transparent recommendations
records.source_check_finding: CDC includes acting on findings; Magenta Book covers intended users and use of evaluation questions; AEA competencies specify communication/facilitation and its principles call for systematic, context-relevant inquiry.
records.item_limit: Recommendations are not findings; distinguish evidence, uncertainty, alternative explanations and stakeholder values.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: Use a quantitative analysis workflow only when the design supports it
records.source_check_finding: Magenta Book links evidence and design to evaluation questions; textbook Chapters 14-15 cover descriptive and inferential analysis; Data Carpentry provides a free social-science data import, cleaning and visualization workflow.
records.item_limit: A reproducible workflow does not repair biased sampling, invalid measures, confounding or unsupported causal claims; the Carpentries lesson is marked alpha.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: IBM SPSS for a justified social-data analysis
records.source_check_finding: OpenLearn labels its seven-activity SPSS introduction a free course and states learning outcomes for variable definitions, data entry and basic hypothesis-testing analysis.
records.item_limit: Course use requires no SPSS installation, but applying SPSS to real data may require licensed software; software operation does not justify the procedure or inference.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review

records.label: NVivo or Taguette for documented qualitative coding
records.source_check_finding: Taguette's official getting-started guide documents importing, tagging/highlighting and exporting codebooks and project material; the textbook's Chapters 12-13 cover interpretive research and qualitative analysis. NVivo remains a commercial alternative, not a free learning route.
records.item_limit: Coding software organizes material; it does not choose a method, make themes true, establish representativeness or replace researcher interpretation. Check hosting, confidentiality and licence terms.
records.student_visibility: hidden; no approval or promotion in this review
